items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai (Race to Dubai finale)
items.line: McIlroy and Hatton share the 36-hole lead at -5 and play together in Saturday's final pairing. McIlroy is 534 pts behind Race leader Chacarra (-1, T11) and takes a record-tying 8th Race to Dubai title if he wins, or finishes 2nd without a Chacarra win. Final-round times are approximate.
